text:
hara: Quick note from an onboarding run: Rust sampleapp with Paginator+prefetch causes synchronized token refreshes and a gateway 429 spike when using short-lived STS.

hara: Repro: spawn 16 async tasks each iterating the Paginator with prefetch=2, set STS TTL=12s, wait ~90s. We see repeated 401->many refresh->429 windows.

evan: Paste of minimal use:```rust
let p = Paginator::new("/v1/embeds").page_size(64).prefetch(2);
for page in p {
  tokio::spawn(async move { client.embed(page).await.unwrap(); });
}
```

evan: Rust auth middleware does `if token.expired() { refresh().await }` with no in-flight dedupe, so each task races to refresh.

mike: We have promise-singleflight in JS, singleflight in Go, lock in Py/C# planned. Rust needs a Future dedupe (store a shared JoinHandle/oneshot).

hara: Immediate mitigations: lower prefetch to 0 or set sampleapp default max_concurrency=4. Also add a tiny client-side refresh lock in the sample app as stopgap.

mike: Proposed plan: (1) add an AuthInFlight dedupe in rust-sdk auth transport (use Arc<Mutex<Option<JoinHandle<_>>>> or futures::lock + oneshot), (2) add pause-on-consecutive-401s in Paginator, (3) update sampleapp onboarding note about STS TTL and defaults.

ci-bot: CI queued for branch rust/auth-dedupe  build started.

ops-bot: staging metrics: `2026-05-05T08:17:21Z gateway 429 rate_limit tenant=acct-beta concurrent=16 path=/v1/embeds delta=+140%`

hara: I'll open the sampleapp patch with the quick lock fix and add repro script. Please add a small CI test that fakes rotating creds and asserts single refresh per rotation.

mike: Will add unit + integration test in rust-sdk CI. Thanks all for fast triage.
